name: travel
title: player:travel
lead: Sends the player to another world of the group, at `pos` or its spawn.

usedIn.quote: `player:travel(dimension, pos)` sends a player to any world of the group, at
routes.add{ from = "dungeon", to = "overworld" }  -- no trigger: only player:travel takes it
player:travel("dungeon", vec3(0.5, 65, 0.5))      -- to a point, or without one to its spawn
